searchIntent: Informational search by readers looking to diagnose why they have stubborn breakouts on their cheeks and how to address them.
audienceAnxieties: Fear of permanent rolling or ice-pick scars since cheek skin is thin and heals slowly

competitorGaps: Competitors fail to mention heavy hair oils dripping onto cheeks during Champi
Competitors ignore dirty helmet straps and pollution film buildup on phone screens
recommendedAngle: A comprehensive physical friction and habit-based diagnostic self-audit combining external screen/helmet triggers with gut-skin and dental links.
